headline_stat.name: significant precessing cell-directions (median signed circular-linear r)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track is the canonical place-cell/theta-precession dataset, an expert's default choice.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile with disk cache; direction-specific rate maps, explicit place-field inclusion criteria (peak rate, SI shuffle, spike count, field width), and correct LFP/spike/position alignment.
justification.analysis: Kempter et al. circular-linear correlation with a sign from circular-linear regression slope, 1000-permutation null, plus per-traversal correlations and a time-shift SI shuffle for field selection, all appropriate circular statistics.
justification.correctness: Reported values (83 significant, 79 negative vs 4 positive, median r -0.32, median slope -0.52, 81% negative per-traversal) reproduce from the committed code and are internally consistent with the JSON and figures.
justification.figures: Example cells selected by correlation strength show clean negative slopes, the volcano and slope/correlation histograms are labeled with units and n, and the pooled density shows the classic precession band.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the 4 non-precessing positives are reported, but no explicit limitation (single session) is stated, so a clean strong result sits at 3 rather than 4.
justification.verdict: Sound, canonical, reproducible demonstration of theta phase precession that I would accept from a rotation student.
